                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,

                agent_run_id TEXT REFERENCES agent_run(id),
                tombstoned_at TEXT,
                version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, content_digest TEXT
                        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'sha256:legacy-uncomputed'
                        CHECK(length(content_digest) > 0), presentation_json TEXT, structured_content_json TEXT
                CHECK(
                    structured_content_json IS NULL
                    OR json_valid(structured_content_json)
                ), effective_recipient_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'
                CHECK(json_valid(effective_recipient_ids_json)), recipient_set_digest TEXT, recipient_presentation_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
                CHECK(json_valid(recipient_presentation_json)), source_operation_id TEXT, agent_addressing_mode TEXT
                    CHECK(agent_addressing_mode IN ('automatic', 'public_only')), source_attachments_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'
                CHECK(json_valid(source_attachments_json)
                    AND json_type(source_attachments_json) = 'array'), quotes_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK(json_valid(quotes_json) AND json_type(quotes_json)='array'), origin_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'legacy'
                    CHECK(origin_kind IN (
                        'legacy', 'local_composer', 'agent', 'automation',
                        'channel', 'mission', 'system'
                    )), recall_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ineligible'
                    CHECK(recall_state IN ('ineligible', 'recallable', 'closed', 'withdrawn')), withdrawn_by_id TEXT, withdrawn_at TEXT,
                UNIQUE(camp_id, sequence)
            )

CREATE TABLE "event_log" (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                event_id TEXT UNIQUE,

                task_id TEXT REFERENCES task(id),
                turn_id TEXT,
                sequence INTEGER,
                event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
                native_method TEXT,
                payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,

                camp_id TEXT,
                entity_type TEXT,
                entity_id TEXT,
                actor_type TEXT,
                actor_id TEXT,
                source_agent_run_id TEXT,
                execution_epoch INTEGER,

                command_id TEXT,
                command_type TEXT,
                request_digest TEXT,
                request_digest_version INTEGER,
                result_status TEXT,
                result_code TEXT,
                result_payload_json TEXT,
                result_entity_type TEXT,
                result_entity_id TEXT,

                created_at TEXT NOT NULL, global_sequence INTEGER, command_client_id TEXT,

                CHECK (
                    (event_type = 'command.result'
                        AND command_id IS NOT NULL
                        AND command_type IS NOT NULL
                        
                        
                        AND result_status IS NOT NULL
                        AND result_code IS NOT NULL
                        AND result_payload_json IS NOT NULL)
                    OR
                    (event_type <> 'command.result'
                        AND command_id IS NULL
                        AND command_type IS NULL
                        AND request_digest IS NULL
                        AND request_digest_version IS NULL
                        AND result_status IS NULL
                        AND result_code IS NULL
                        AND result_payload_json IS NULL
                        AND result_entity_type IS NULL
                        AND result_entity_id IS NULL)
                ),
                CHECK (
                    (result_entity_type IS NULL AND result_entity_id IS NULL)
                    OR
                    (result_entity_type IS NOT NULL AND result_entity_id IS NOT NULL)
                )
            )

CREATE INDEX camp_directory_project_idx
                    ON camp(project_path)
                    WHERE project_binding_kind = 'directory'

CREATE INDEX camp_activation_state_idx
                ON camp(activation_state, updated_at, id)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX camp_message_camp_identity_unique
                ON camp_message(camp_id, id)

CREATE INDEX camp_message_navigation_activity_idx
                    ON camp_message(camp_id, author_type, created_at)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX camp_message_source_operation_unique
                ON camp_message(source_operation_id)
                WHERE source_operation_id IS NOT NULL

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX camp_deletion_operation_unique
                ON camp(deletion_operation_id)
                WHERE deletion_operation_id IS NOT NULL

CREATE INDEX camp_deletion_due_idx
                ON camp(deletion_attention_required, deletion_next_attempt_at,
                        deletion_requested_at, id)
                WHERE deletion_operation_id IS NOT NULL

CREATE INDEX camp_navigation_window_idx ON camp (
    CASE WHEN project_binding_kind = 'directory' THEN 'directory:' || project_path ELSE 'quick-chat' END,
    COALESCE(navigation_activity_at, created_at) DESC,
    navigation_activity_sequence DESC, id
) WHERE deletion_operation_id IS NULL
CREATE INDEX camp_message_direct_reply_idx ON camp_message(camp_id, reply_to_camp_message_id, sequence, id) WHERE reply_to_camp_message_id IS NOT NULL

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX event_command_result_unique
                ON event_log(command_id)
                WHERE command_id IS NOT NULL

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX event_global_sequence_unique
                ON event_log(global_sequence)
                WHERE global_sequence IS NOT NULL

CREATE INDEX event_log_camp_global_sequence_idx
                    ON event_log(camp_id, global_sequence)
                    WHERE camp_id IS NOT NULL AND global_sequence IS NOT NULL

CREATE INDEX event_log_entity_sequence_idx
                ON event_log(entity_type, entity_id, event_type, global_sequence)
                WHERE entity_type IS NOT NULL
                  AND entity_id IS NOT NULL
                  AND global_sequence IS NOT NULL

CREATE INDEX event_task_idx
                ON event_log(task_id, sequence)
                WHERE task_id IS NOT NULL

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX event_task_sequence_unique
                ON event_log(task_id, sequence)
                WHERE task_id IS NOT NULL AND sequence IS NOT NULL

CREATE INDEX camp_history_uninitialized_idx ON camp(id)
    WHERE history_activity_initialized=0 AND deletion_operation_id IS NULL

CREATE INDEX camp_history_directory_idx ON camp(julianday(COALESCE(history_activity_at,created_at)) DESC,id)
    WHERE deletion_operation_id IS NULL

CREATE INDEX camp_message_history_activity_idx ON camp_message(camp_id,julianday(created_at) DESC,id,created_at)
    WHERE tombstoned_at IS NULL AND recall_state <> 'withdrawn'
